aggregation: equal-image arithmetic means on RAW clean sources, before resize/registration

formulas.background_mask: gray>.8 AND farther than 5px square radius from gray<.7; 5px border excluded
formulas.estimated_noise: mean absolute Immerkaer 3x3 response on mask * sqrt(pi/2)/6

limitation: Background and high-frequency proxies are not calibrated sensor noise. White fraction and edge density depend on margins, ink coverage, font, diagrams and content. No restoration parameter is selected from them.
